<issue>Issue Title: workflow completion callback capabilities on DurableAgent
Description:
When running agent.run, if an in-flight workflow contains an activity that calls something like os.Exit(), the entire app is terminated once that activity executes.
After fixing the activity logic (e.g., removing the os.Exit() call), the workflow resumes and eventually completes successfully. At that point, I can see the logs (pretty-printed workflow conversation).
However, as an end user, I want a way to programmatically retrieve the workflow result once it completes, rather than just relying on logs.
We should introduce a mechanism such as an onWorkflowCompletion callback field on the agent. This would allow developers to define a handler that automatically receives the result of the .run call once the workflow finishes.
This would make it easier to:
- React to workflow completions.
- Capture and process results directly in application logic.
- Avoid relying solely on logs for completion details.
</issue>

1. What does this part of the code do?

The DurableAgent class extends AgentBase and has many parameters for customization. It has several properties and methods related to workflow execution:
- It has a method agent_workflow decorated as a workflow entry and message router. Likely the main workflow.
- It has other methods for handling messages, calling LLM, running tools, broadcasting messages, sending responses, and finalizing the workflow.
- Lifecycle methods start, stop, register, register_workflows for managing the agent.
- A runtime property presumably to access the workflow runtime.

2. What is the relationship between this part of the code and the bug?

The bug concerns the run method which presumably starts and manages workflow execution inside DurableAgent. The current results or completions are only visible in logs but not programmatically retrievable. The presence or absence of any workflow completion callback or result handling here would be directly related to the bug and the feature request for onWorkflowCompletion callback.

3. Given the issue description, what would be the intended behavior of this part of the code?

The intended behavior is having a way to register a callback or similar mechanism on the DurableAgent that would be called automatically once a workflow run completes with the workflow result. It would allow the user to get the workflow results programmatically instead of relying solely on logs.
